title: Développement Régénératif en Pratique, Québec
description: The same journey in regenerative practice, offered in French for French-speaking practitioners worldwide, with a special welcome for the Franco-Canadian community. January to June 2027; Online, with a three-day intensive at Centre de Vie, Petite Nation, Québec; Paid, with sliding scale and scholarships. Offered by Regenesis Institute for Regenerative Practice. Listed in the Relational River's Springs; join through the makers' own page.
